messages:
jamie_infra: Heads up — scheduling a preventive window for az10 tonight 02:00–03:30 UTC. Observed persistent BMC flaps on 4 nodes in pool-gpu-a (rack 7/8). They move between online/unreachable and occasionally drop power state. Plan: cohort cordon+drain, soft-reboot BMC, swap egress routing for long-tail jobs to az11, and backfill capacity before user-facing canaries. Low-risk but want ops + platform onstandby. :warning:

sara_oncall: Are any Dedicated customers pinned to that pool? SLA impact?

jamie_infra: No Dedicated pinned VMs in that cohort — mostly hosted inference and some spot-backed batch. We still expect ephemeral regen for a few latency-sensitive requests if we're not careful.

mike_sre: Suggest batch size = 2 nodes drain every 12m to avoid synchronous KV-cache misses. Also enable prefix cache warm-up on backfill instances.

liam_platform: I'll pre-warm 8 on-demand instances in az11 20m before drains start. That buys us warm KV caches and avoids heavy cross-region tail latency. Cost estimate: ~ $280 for the window (on-demand GPU instances) vs $55 if we risk filling with spot (but higher preemption risk).

heidi_eng: Can we route egress-only heavy workloads (embeddings indexers) to az11 during the window? We want to avoid model reroutes for low-latency API clients.

jamie_infra: Yes — plan is to add temporary route policy: prefer az11 for flows tagged 'batch' and keep latency SLO traffic pinned to az10 as long as nodes remain Ready. If a node flips to NotReady we'll failover to az11.

ops-bot: Incident task created: INC-az10-bmc-flap-2026-3951234567, runbook /runbooks/az10-bmc-flap.md assigned to jamie_infra, sara_oncall.

mike_sre: Runbook steps I want in thread:
1) cordon node
2) drain with --grace-period=120 --timeout=600 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
3) soft-reboot BMC via ipmi/ipmitool or vendor API
4) validate S.M.A.R.T + nvme and GPU health before rejoining

jamie_infra: Exact commands I'll run (paste to ops channel when doing it):
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-az10-012
kubectl drain gpu-node-az10-012 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=600
# if drain hangs: kubectl describe pod <pod> / kubectl delete pod --force
# vendor: ipmitool -I lanplus -H <bmc> -U admin -P $BMC_PASS chassis power cycle
```

sara_oncall: How long to keep node out of rotation after BMC reboot? We usually wait for k8s node.conditions Ready + nv_peer_check. Propose 10m warm window and then rejoin with label rollout=canary for 2 minutes, then full return.

liam_platform: I'll add an annotation to the node when rejoining: platform/prewarmed=yes and add to warm_backfill pool so autoscaler prefers them for warm jobs.

heidi_eng: What about caching layer TTL and repop policy? We should bump prefix-cache TTL to 30m for this cohort backfill so answers don't regenerate cold.

jamie_infra: Agreed. Will set prefix_cache_ttl=1800s for the backfill route. Also we'll reduce batch concurrency on new nodes to 0.6 for first 15m to avoid saturation.

mike_sre: Monitoring checks:
- grafana: az10-gpu-pool -> GPU temp, BMC ping failures, Node Ready %
- datadog: tail 502 spikes for inference-api routes
- tracing: sampling for canaries to catch latency regressions
If any spike > 30% from baseline rollback plan: stop further drains, revert route changes, and add more on-demand nodes in az11.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: route-policy/az10->az11-batch-swap v1.2 at 2026-11-12T02:10:00Z (manual approval required).

jamie_infra: Timeline:
- 01:40 UTC: pre-warm 8 on-demand in az11 (liam)
- 02:00 UTC: start cohort drain (2 nodes every 12m)
- 02:00–03:30 UTC: BMC reboot + validation loop
- 03:30 UTC: final node rejoin and route-policy revert check

sara_oncall: I'll be on-call for the window. If anything odd ping #incidents and @mike_sre.

liam_platform: Pre-warm commands: cloudctl provision --region=az11 --type=gpu-v2 --count=8 --tag warm_backfill
Then run: backfill-warmup --pool=pool-gpu-a --prefetch-prefixes=1000

heidi_eng: Heads up to product: I'll post short comms to #customer-impact if we see any errors > 1% for 10m. Prefer no customer-visible impact.

mike_sre: Quick cost note for postmortem: we used on-demand for reliability. Add a line item for ~ $300–350 in the maintenance window to the ops cost ledger.

jamie_infra: All right — locking in. If no objections by 18:00 UTC I'll run the ops ticket and start approvals. Thanks. :white_check_mark:

sara_oncall: ✅ approved from oncall side.

liam_platform: ✅ provisioning prepped. Will post cloud links when ready.

mike_sre: 👍 I'll watch metrics and have rollback steps ready.
